gloss: right to use; usage rights; license

definitions.gloss: right to use; usage rights; license
definitions.explanation: The legal right to use a piece of property, land, software, or intellectual work, as distinct from owning it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使用権|しようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: To obtain the right to use the land.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使用権|しようけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一年間|いちねんかん}→一年間：28882_ichinenkan⟧だ。
examples.english: The license to use this software lasts one year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{移|うつ}ら→移る：01232_utsuru⟧ず、{使用権|しようけん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{与|あた}えられる→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Ownership does not transfer; only the right to use is granted.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ (use) plus {権|けん} (right). Names the right to use something without necessarily owning it, common in contracts for land, facilities, and software.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使用権|しようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧: to grant a right of use
- {使用権|しようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to acquire usage rights
- ⟦ソフトウェア→ソフトウェア：04719_sofutowea⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{使用権|しようけん}: software license

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{所有権|しょゆうけん}→所有権：17082_shoyuuken⟧: ownership; title — the right to own, which the usage right does not include
- {利用権|りようけん}: right of use — near-synonym, often for public facilities and services
